title: Ing kaladwa keng gulut ning idolo
intro: keng anino ning maragul a pamaglakbe ibat keng tirania, ining misteryosung pigura menaya ya keng ilang. Kabang ing pamuntuk ning metung a piniling balen mumukiat ya king metung a sagradung bunduk para king banal a pamisanmetung, metung a maragul a kapagsubukan ing miras karing mitagan. Ing indibidwal ayni ginamit ne ing oras para ibayu ing kapaniwalan ning mabilug a komunidad. Inyang mibalik ya ing pamuntuk a maki katutuan, metung a e karaniwan at alang anggang parusa ing mitakda. Malyari meng abalu nung ninu ya ining kontrobersyal at tuso a kaladwa?
clues: Miglakbe ku kayabe da ring taung miligtas king upaya na ning metung a mayupayang mapang-api king kapamilatan da ring makapagmulalang tanda.
Inyang minukiat ya ing karelang pamuntuk king bunduk ban tanggap patnube, menaya ku libutad da ring mitagan.
tinipun kung mangamal a metal ibat kareng karelang palamuti at gewa ku lang bage a magpalwal siwala.
Kapamilatan na niting pamaglalang, mekumbinsi ku ing mabilug a henerasyun na ikit de ing karelang dios keng ilang.
Inyang mibalik ya ing lider, mepili ku at kitang da nung nanu ing meging sangkan ning pamaglinlang ku.
Ing parusa ku keti king yatu ya pin ing alang tatagkil kanaku o lumapit, tanda ning kamarinayan a daralan ku kapilan man.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
